## Architecture Overview

The `storageExporter` struct in `jaeger/cmd/jaeger/internal/exporters/storageexporter/exporter.go` is the bridge between the OTel Collector pipeline and Jaeger storage backends. It is constructed by `newExporter()` and used via the factory pattern registered in `components.go`. Adding a required field `BatchConfig BatchSettings` breaks the struct literal in `newExporter()` and all test instantiations.

## Detailed Analysis

### Core Implementation

- **`exporter.go`** (lines 19-24) — Defines the `storageExporter` struct. The `newExporter()` function (lines 26-32) constructs the struct literal. Adding a required field means the constructor must initialize it.
- **`config.go`** — Defines the `Config` struct for the exporter. The new `BatchConfig` field would need configuration support here.
- **`factory.go`** — The `createTracesExporter()` function (lines 39-52) instantiates the exporter via `newExporter()`. Must pass the new field.
- **`exporter_test.go`** — Contains direct `&storageExporter{}` struct instantiations in test cases (lines 74, 93). All tests constructing the struct directly break.
- **`factory_test.go`** — Tests factory creation logic and validates configuration.

### Component Registration

- **`components.go`** — Imports and registers storageexporter factory (line 39, line 116). The `NewFactory()` call must continue working.

### Configuration Files

Multiple YAML configs reference `jaeger_storage_exporter`:
